title: Ruuh bu am solo bi laaj kiliftéef
intro: Ci jaar-jaaru Al Quran, amoon na ku dëkkoon ku am alal ak xam-xam bu ñépp xam. Ruuh googu dafa génn ci suuf si, yor ay takkaay ak ay alal yuy yéem ñi ko doon seetaan, waaye seen xol di gëna réy ndax réy-réy. Nu ngi leen di jox leeral ci kumpa bi ci benn ci léeb yi gëna am solo ci Al Quran, di barab bu gëna mag ci alal daje ak njeexte lu woyof ci suufu suuf si juddoo seen alal.
clues: Ma génn ci suuf si ma defaree ay takkaay yuy xëcc bëtu ñépp.
Amoon naa alal ju bari ak xam-xam bu xóot, loolu moo ma wuutale ci ñeneen ñi.
Bi ab Yonent ñëwee di woo nit ñi ci Yàlla, damay laaj seen kiliftéef ak mbegte.
Ñi ma wër dañu may wax ci sama bopp ni, Yàlla taxul ma am alal.
Sama askan yéemu ci sama mag, ñu bëggoon ñu mel sama ëlëg.
Samay tabax yu rafet yi dañu leen wann lëmm ci suuf si ni yar bu Yàlla.

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
